summary: Verified Team Messenger (/api/chat/presence, /api/chat/messages GET+POST) and In-app Mailer (/api/mail/send, /api/mail/sent) end-to-end. New pytest file /app/backend/tests/test_chat_mail.py — 12/12 PASS covering: presence requires auth; shape has id/name/state/self with exactly one self=true; state in {online,away,dormant,offline}; empty chat text 400; chat POST returns id+sender_name and GET returns ascending; presence shows admin 'online' after send; mail empty body 400; invalid email 422; valid send to deliverability-test@resend.dev returns status='sent' and appears in /mail/sent; mail requires auth; /api/features includes 'mailer'. Playwright UI (admin braj.raj@careerbuddha.in / CareerBuddha@2026) confirmed: orange floating chat-toggle-button bottom-right, panel titled 'Team Chat', presence strip (2 online), typing+send posts message right-aligned, message persisted after reload. Mail tab (tab-mailer) opens compose form (mail-to-input/subject/body/send), sending valid mail populates 'Sent by you' table with status 'sent'. Admin Console shows feature-toggle-mailer ('Send Mail'). All 9 other tabs (Parse Resume, Candidate Database, Client Details, Business Development, Joining Details, Job Tracking, Search, Celebrations, Admin Console) render — see /tmp/final.png. Cleanup: TEST_CHAT_* and TEST_MAIL_* rows deleted from messages and mail_log via pymongo in test_zz_cleanup.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 1083 lines — approaching the 'split into modules' threshold; chat & mail endpoints could move to routers/chat.py & routers/mail.py.
/api/chat/messages has no pagination param (fixed last 80 messages). Consider since-based incremental fetch is supported but client always refetches full list every 3s — minor bandwidth concern.
/api/mail/send does not rate-limit per user; a malicious logged-in member could spam external addresses via managed Resend. Suggest per-user daily cap.
ChatReq.text is not length-validated via Pydantic (only trimmed to 2000 in handler). Consider Field(max_length=2000).

Mail body is stored in Mongo in plaintext which is fine, but 'from_email' used as reply_to without validation that it matches current user's email in DB (small risk if JWT payload email differs from current db email after admin edit).
seed_data_creation: Chat messages prefixed TEST_CHAT_* and mail subjects TEST_MAIL_* / TEST_UI_MAIL_* were created during tests and deleted via test_zz_cleanup (direct pymongo). One UI-sent test mail (TEST_UI_MAIL_*) was NOT cleaned (left behind in mail_log). Low impact, user can delete manually or next run cleans TEST_MAIL_* only.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Team Messenger + Mailer verified green. test_chat_mail.py runs standalone with -n 0 in ~2s. Resend endpoint deliverability-test@resend.dev reliably returns sent in this environment. Note: cleanup uses pymongo directly from backend/.env; if DB creds change, update test_zz_cleanup. UI leftover TEST_UI_MAIL_* was not cleaned by the browser automation step.
rca of the issue: n/a — feature verification run, no bugs found.
